title: Care continues through sharp changes

captions.energy: Supporting the life of shared activity

meaning: Actions around an unstable foundation breaking down to preserve growth are emotionally accompanied by further turns in circumstances.
text: The Tower in the physical position of this Energy Field describes shared actions when exposed instability sharply disrupts an earlier arrangement. You may dismantle a failed structure or stop relying on an unconfirmed scheme. The Empress in energy motivates care for development and tangible fruits of attention. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions adds the experience of changing circumstances. Sharply altered practice can therefore be supported by a creative motive while the emotional response continues to turn with events. Care guarantees no convenient outcome and does not automatically justify the original failure.

For example, old seedling boxes fall apart and you remove the plants together. Wanting to preserve them supports urgent work. One temporary position proves inconvenient, another works better, and frustration gives way to relief followed by another concern. **We care for something living while circumstances still change before our eyes.** Emotional alternation concerns an actual situation; it proves neither insufficient care nor a need for the damage itself. The plants matter while your experience of the work remains changeable.

A difficulty arises if growth becomes a demand to enjoy every turn. Tiredness is hidden, and a replacement is hurriedly called successful before it has been tested. The Empress requires no endless increase in effort, and the Wheel promises no favourable next event. The Tower matters through the earlier foundation’s instability and actual disruption; it does not make every subsequent adjustment beneficial or distribute blame between the two people. A creative response remains distinct from justification.
